4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.

<script>
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
  const startBtn = document.getElementById('startBtn');
  const W = 960, H = 600, TILE = 48, MAP_X = 0, MAP_Y = 12;
  const mapRows = [
    '####################',
    '#....#.......#.....#',
    '#.##.#.#####.#.###.#',
    '#.#..#...#...#...#.#',
    '#.#.###..#..###..#.#',
    '#...#....#.....#...#',
    '###.#.######.#.###.#',
    '#...#....#...#.....#',
    '#.######.#.#####.#.#',
    '#........#.......#.#',
    '#.#########.#####..#',
    '####################'
  ];
  const walls = mapRows.map(row => [...row].map(c => c === '#'));
  const scoreEl = document.getElementById('score');
  const livesEl = document.getElementById('lives');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('sliceCount');
  const progressEl = document.getElementById('progress');
  const timerEl = document.getElementById('timer');
  const headline = document.getElementById('headline');
  const message = document.getElementById('message');
  const soundBtn = document.getElementById('soundBtn');
  let dpr = 1, running = false, won = false, last = 0, elapsed = 0, timeLeft = 60;
  let score = 0, lives = 3, collected = 0, slices = [], particles = [];
  let audioOn = false, audioCtx = null, shake = 0, flash = 0;
  const keys = new Set(), touchDirs = new Set();
  const player = {x: 1.5*TILE, y: 1.5*TILE, r: 13, speed: 175, dx: 1, dy: 0, dash: 0, dashCd: 0, invuln: 0};
  const pizza = {x: 18.5*TILE, y: 10.5*TILE, r: 18, speed: 64, angle: 0};
  const rand = (a,b) => a + Math.random()*(b-a);
  function resize(){
    const rect = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
    dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width*dpr); canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height*dpr);
    ctx.setTransform(canvas.width/W,0,0,canvas.height/H,0,0);
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize); resize();
  function wallAt(px,py){
    const c=Math.floor((px-MAP_X)/TILE), r=Math.floor((py-MAP_Y)/TILE);
    return r<0 || c<0 || r>=walls.length || c>=walls[0].length || walls[r][c];
  }
  function hitsWall(x,y,r){
    return wallAt(x-r,y-r)||wallAt(x+r,y-r)||wallAt(x-r,y+r)||wallAt(x+r,y+r)||wallAt(x,y-r)||wallAt(x,y+r)||wallAt(x-r,y)||wallAt(x+r,y);
  }
  function movePlayer(dx,dy,dt){
    const speed = player.speed * (player.dash>0 ? 2.45 : 1);
    const nx=player.x+dx*speed*dt, ny=player.y+dy*speed*dt;
    if(!hitsWall(nx,player.y,player.r)) player.x=nx;
    if(!hitsWall(player.x,ny,player.r)) player.y=ny;
  }
  function spawnSlices(){
    slices=[];
    let tries=0;
    while(slices.length<8&&tries++<1000){
      const c=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*18), r=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*9);
      if(walls[r][c]) continue;
      const x=(c+.5)*TILE, y=MAP_Y+(r+.5)*TILE;
      if(Math.hypot(x-player.x,y-player.y)<100||Math.hypot(x-pizza.x,y-pizza.y)<80) continue;
      if(slices.some(s=>Math.hypot(s.x-x,s.y-y)<50)) continue;
      slices.push({x,y,phase:rand(0,6.28),got:false});
    }
  }
  function reset(){
    score=0;lives=3;collected=0;elapsed=0;timeLeft=60;won=false;shake=0;flash=0;particles=[];
    Object.assign(player,{x:1.5*TILE,y:1.5*TILE,dx:1,dy:0,dash:0,dashCd:0,invuln:1.3});
    Object.assign(pizza,{x:18.5*TILE,y:10.5*TILE,speed:64,angle:0});
    spawnSlices(); updateHud();
  }
  function updateHud(){
    scoreEl.textContent=String(score).padStart(4,'0');
    livesEl.textContent=Array.from({length:3},(_,i)=>i<lives?'♥':'♡').join(' ');
    countEl.textContent=collected;progressEl.style.width=(collected/8*100)+'%';timerEl.textContent=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(timeLeft));
  }
  function begin(){reset();running=true;overlay.classList.add('hidden');last=performance.now();if(audioOn) initSound();}
  startBtn.addEventListener('click',begin);
  const keyMap={ArrowUp:'up',KeyW:'up',ArrowDown:'down',KeyS:'down',ArrowLeft:'left',KeyA:'left',ArrowRight:'right',KeyD:'right'};
  window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
    if(keyMap[e.code]){keys.add(keyMap[e.code]);e.preventDefault();}
    if(e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat) dash();}
    if((e.code==='Enter'||e.code==='Space')&&!running) begin();
  });
  window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{if(keyMap[e.code])keys.delete(keyMap[e.code]);});
  function dash(){if(!running||player.dashCd>0)return;player.dash=.19;player.dashCd=1.15;player.invuln=Math.max(player.invuln,.23);sound(430,.08);}
  document.querySelectorAll('.touch-pad button').forEach(btn=>{
    const dir=btn.dataset.dir;
    btn.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();btn.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);touchDirs.add(dir);});
    const release=e=>{e.preventDefault();touchDirs.delete(dir);};
    btn.addEventListener('pointerup',release);btn.addEventListener('pointercancel',release);btn.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',()=>touchDirs.delete(dir));
  });
  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(e.pointerType==='touch'&&running&&e.target===canvas)dash();});
  soundBtn.addEventListener('click',()=>{audioOn=!audioOn;soundBtn.textContent=audioOn?'♫':'♪';soundBtn.style.color=audioOn?'#ffca66':'';if(audioOn)initSound();});
  function initSound(){if(!audioCtx)audioCtx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume();}
  function sound(freq=520,duration=.09){if(!audioOn)return;initSound();const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.055,audioCtx.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,audioCtx.currentTime+duration);o.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start();o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+duration);}
